title: L204: A setting documented for one release only is read by no page
description:
guide.install.timeout is documented only from release 2.1, and no page uses it; put it in the reference or delete it

Rule: A setting documented for one release only is read by no page
Fix (decision): move it to the reference, or read it from a page
